summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited, a Nasdaq-listed biomedical company (CUPR), filed a 6-K reporting the closing of the underwriters' over-allotment option tied to its September 17, 2026 public offering. The company sold an additional 648,373 Class A ordinary shares at $1.15 per share, raising about $745,629 in gross proceeds and bringing total offering gross proceeds to roughly $5,716,491 before discounts and expenses. Representative R. F. Lafferty received warrants for 25,935 shares at a $1.265 exercise price. This is a routine capital-raising follow-on, not a special situation; watch share overhang and warrant dilution.
